We have a health crisis in America

maybe slowing down is the whole point. even though you all warned me that “the days are long, but the years are short,” this first year with my baby girl evaporated in the blink of an eye… what I wouldn’t give for one more newborn snuggle, hearing her laugh like this for the first time, seeing the light in her eyes as she takes her first steps, and her needing to hold my hand for just a little bit longer. there is truly nothing more beautiful in my life than being your mama, sweet girl 🤍
The sweetest weekend showering our ONE YEAR OLD with so much love from her friends and family 🤍 we love being your Mom & Dad, Isla girl!!
… the woman was too stunned to speak
Do you guys think this is real?? 🧐🧐🧐
We shouldn’t romanticize killing babies for political gain.
I can’t believe it’s already been a year since I gave birth 😭
no one prepared me for how emotional it is rocking your baby to sleep the night before her first birthday 😭 thank you, God, for the best year of my life.
Congress needs 535 Brandon Gills.
Not my baby being exposed to BLANKETS and MEDICINE and FOOD
